title: 第11章 夜闯召府第12章 都是些什么妖怪
slug: 快穿之时空星河伴第九章误闯雾山
content_zh:
昔小苑有些不耐烦说道：“快放开，在不放开我就……”
俞月白脸颊有些泛红，怼回去说道：“你能对我怎么样！”
昔小苑狠下心来，说道：“这是你逼我的！”
昔小苑摸到俞月白的腰，抓住腰带直接一扒，俞月白的衣裳松了开来。
俞月白一脸的震惊，立马抓着衣裳裹好自己，一脸的不可置信的看着昔小苑说道：“你还真的要在大庭广众之下对我做不愧之事！！”
沐梓丞直接大跌眼镜，这女人还有救吗？沐梓丞摇了摇头哀叹的说道：“哎！你怕是要嫁不出去了……”
张文看着丞相做出这种事，他自己都默默的缩了缩，不知道哪天会不会被丞相给猥琐了……
昔小苑直接对他们翻了个大大的白眼，而后对俞月白说道：“谁让你不放开的！”
随后瞪着那些地痞流氓说道：“你们想让我放了你们也可以，但是要答应我一件事。”
流氓眉头一皱的说道：“还有什么事？”
昔小苑说道：“三天，帮忙给老百姓们施粥，现在就开始！三天过后就放了你们。来人！把他们带下去看牢了。”
不等地痞流氓有什么抗议就被带了下去。
地痞流氓一脸的冤枉，吃个饭而已…都能被人给揍了还得当苦力，真是倒霉透了，怕是今天出门没看黄历。
俞月白脸红彤彤的，一脸欲言又止，说道：“你…你！本公子要娶你！”
昔小苑一脸的不可置信的说道：“什嘛？本丞相没听错吧？？”
啥玩意？娶她？
俞月白咬了咬牙，虽然有些不好意思说出来，但是狠下决心的说道：“对！本公子要娶你，既…既然你都摸了本公子，还…还解了本公子的腰带，你非得嫁我不可！”
昔小苑默默的灌了一口茶，突然假装喝醉了的说道：“本丞相醉茶了，本丞相什么都听不见…”
丫的，快跑！
张文有些关心的对昔小苑说道：“丞相没事吧？在下这就扶丞相您回去歇息吧。”

昔小苑立马拒绝说道：“不用不用~”
俞月白看昔小苑这样有些小生气，本公子都放下脸来说娶你，你竟然就跑了？？
沐梓丞坐着冷静的喝了口茶定定神。
昔小苑假装走路有些踉踉跄跄的溜了，而后麻溜的立马回到房间‘彭~’的一声把门关上了。
吓死她…谁要嫁给他呀，不就解了下腰带嘛…
行吧，古代人思想是比较传统的。
夜晚，今晚的月亮很亮很亮，给黑夜里添了些许光亮，就像一盏夜明灯一样。
微风吹起，带来一股清凉风，夜里的植物吸收着二氧化碳，微风拂过树叶‘沙沙沙—’的响，夜里有两个黑影到处闯着，而后消失在夜里。
门突然开了，些许凉风吹了进去，凉凉的风把入睡中的召簧给冷醒了，睁开眼睛便看到打开的大门。
召簧迷迷糊糊的起身打算把门关上，这风还有些冷飕飕的，他刚走到大门上，窗户也突然开了，摇晃着，窗户传来朽木‘咔咔咔’的声音，像极了夜里哭泣的小孩……
召簧打了个冷颤，两手摸了摸自己的手臂，怎么今晚有些怪怪的，而且这窗户怎么突然这么的吓人。
打算关门的召簧看见门上突然掉下来一个东西，召簧一看顿时吓得差点魂飞魄散，门口掉挂下来一个白衣女子，头发长长看不见脸，整个人在门口处飘呀飘的……
content_en:
Xi Xiaoyuan said impatiently: "Let go quickly. If you don't let me go, I will..."
Yu Yuebai's cheeks were a little red, and he said back, "What can you do to me!"
Xi Xiaoyuan calmed down and said, "You forced me to do this!"
Xi Xiaoyuan touched Yu Yuebai's waist, grabbed the belt and pulled it open, causing Yu Yuebai's clothes to loosen.
Yu Yuebai looked shocked, immediately grabbed his clothes and wrapped himself up, looked at Xi Xiaoyuan with disbelief and said: "You are really going to do something worthy of me in public!!"
Mu Zicheng was shocked. Can this woman be saved? Mu Zicheng shook his head and lamented: "Hey! I'm afraid you won't be able to get married..."
Zhang Wen watched the Prime Minister do such a thing, and he shrank silently, wondering if one day he would be despised by the Prime Minister...
Xi Xiaoyuan rolled her eyes at them, and then said to Yu Yuebai, "Who told you not to let go!"
Then he glared at the ruffians and said, "You can let me go if you want, but you have to promise me one thing."
The gangster frowned and said, "Is there anything else?"
Xi Xiaoyuan said: "For three days, help give porridge to the people. Start now! I will let you go after three days. Someone! Take them down to jail."
The gangsters were taken away without waiting for any protest.
The local gangsters looked unjust and just had a meal... They were beaten up and had to work as coolies. It was really unlucky. I was afraid that I didn't read the almanac when I went out today.
Yu Yuebai's face was red, but he hesitated to speak, and said: "You...you! This young master wants to marry you!"
Xi Xiaoyuan said with a look of disbelief: "What? Did I, the Prime Minister, hear correctly??"
What the hell? Marry her?
Yu Yuebai gritted his teeth. Although he was a little embarrassed to say it, he said with determination: "Yes! I want to marry you. Since...since you have touched me and...even taken off my belt, you must marry me!"
Xi Xiaoyuan silently took a sip of tea, and suddenly pretended to be drunk and said: "I am drunk with tea. I can't hear anything..."
Damn, run!
Zhang Wen said to Xi Xiaoyuan with some concern: "Is the Prime Minister okay? I will help you go back to rest, Prime Minister."
Xi Xiaoyuan immediately refused and said: "No, no, no~"
Yu Yuebai was a little angry when he saw Xi Xiaoyuan being like this. I even lowered my face and asked to marry you, but you actually ran away? ?
Mu Zicheng sat calmly and took a sip of tea to calm down.
Xi Xiaoyuan pretended to stagger and slipped away, then immediately returned to the room and closed the door with a "Peng~" sound.
Scared her to death...Who wants to marry him? Why don't they just take off their belt...
Okay, ancient people’s thinking was relatively traditional.
At night, the moon tonight is very bright, adding a little light to the dark night, like a night lamp.
The breeze blew, bringing a cool breeze. The plants at night absorbed carbon dioxide. The breeze rustled the leaves, and there were two black figures rushing around at night, and then disappeared into the night.
The door suddenly opened, and a little cool breeze blew in. The cool wind woke up Zhaohuang from his sleep. When he opened his eyes, he saw the open door.
Zhaohuang stood up in a daze and planned to close the door. The wind was still a bit chilly. As soon as he walked to the door, the window suddenly opened and swayed. The sound of rotten wood came from the window, like a child crying at night...
Zhao Huang shuddered and touched his arms with both hands. Why was there something weird tonight, and why was this window suddenly so scary?
Zhao Huang was about to close the door when he saw something suddenly fall on the door. Zhao Huang was so frightened that he almost lost his mind. A woman in white fell down from the door. Her hair was long and her face was invisible. Her whole body was floating at the door...
